import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="f50e6f847d64b32d886732c9e3002336072afa16"

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()
if head != expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in ["src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","src/do_again/browser/cdp.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"]:
    p=wt/rel
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(k in line for k in [
            "def _bootstrap_prompt", "def _page_contains", "def _find_chatgpt_target",
            "def _record_owned_chat", "def queue_verified_archives", "def archive_queue_status",
            "Runtime.evaluate", "Input.dispatch", "user_gesture"
        ]):
            start=max(1,i-6); end=min(len(lines),i+30)
            print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
            for n in range(start,end+1):
                print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")

print("=== repository references to archive UI text/selectors ===")
proc=subprocess.run(
    ["git","grep","-ni","archive\|conversation options\|more options\|delete"],
    cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True
)
print(proc.stdout)
